title: No exceptions allowed
hints: `Result<T, E>` is a union of two object types, told apart by a literal `ok: true` / `ok: false` field.
`ok(value)` just builds `{ ok: true, value }`. Its return type `Result<T, never>` fits anywhere a `Result<T, E>` is expected because `never` is assignable to everything.
In parsePort: trim, check `/^\d+$/.test(s)` → else `err("not a number")`; then `Number(s)` and range-check 1..65535 → `err("out of range")`, otherwise `ok(n)`.
